source_campaign: T002 - Кучета: примерна снимка на автора (само за тест)

banners.prompt:
Create a square portrait photo of a friendly 45-year-old man, a veterinary specialist, short dark hair with a little grey at the temples, light stubble, warm genuine smile, wearing a dark teal veterinary scrub top, kneeling next to a happy golden labrador-like dog with one hand resting on the dog's back. Background: softly blurred bright, clean small veterinary clinic room.
STYLE: natural photorealistic professional portrait, soft daylight, approachable and trustworthy, ordinary Bulgarian person (not a model), colours harmonising with dark teal, warm orange and light mint.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, numbers, logos, name badges or watermarks.
DOG: ordinary family dog, natural anatomy, correct eyes and paws. Hands with five fingers.
The input image is only a blank canvas: fill the whole frame, no borders.
